en.headline: 31-year-old man confirmed with mpox after high-risk contacts in Hong Kong and abroad
en.dek: The patient is stable in isolation at Princess Margaret Hospital; the Centre for Health Protection is tracing contacts and has recorded 20 cases so far this year.
body: The Centre for Health Protection confirmed on Monday that a 31-year-old man had tested positive for the mpox virus. He developed fatigue and rashes on his palms, soles and genital area on 9 September, sought treatment the next day and was admitted to Princess Margaret Hospital for isolation. His condition is stable.

During the incubation period the man had high-risk contact with unknown men both outside Hong Kong and locally. The centre said there was no epidemiological link to earlier local cases. It is contacting people who may have been exposed and will notify the World Health Organization.

Hong Kong has recorded 104 mpox cases since 2022. This year the total stands at 20, including 15 local and five imported infections. Of the 11 cases detected since August, all involved men who have sex with men or bisexual men who reported high-risk sexual activity during the incubation period.

zh.headline: 31歲男子確診猴痘 潛伏期內外地及本港有高風險接觸
zh.dek: 患者情況穩定，在瑪嘉烈醫院隔離治療；今年累計20宗個案，防護中心正追蹤接觸者。
body: 衞生防護中心周一公布，一名31歲男子確診感染猴痘。患者9月9日出現全身乏力，手掌、腳掌及生殖器官有皮疹，翌日到社會衞生科診所求醫，其後轉送瑪嘉烈醫院隔離，目前情況穩定。
患者提供的資料顯示，潛伏期內曾在外地及香港與陌生男子有高風險接觸。中心指暫時未發現與本港早前個案有流行病學關連，正繼續調查並設法聯繫可能的高風險接觸者，亦會通報世界衞生組織。
自2022年至今本港共錄得104宗猴痘個案。今年累計20宗，包括15宗本地及5宗輸入個案。8月以來的11宗個案中，患者均為男男性接觸者或雙性戀男性，並報稱曾進行高風險性行為。
